rubric.role_summary: Mid-level Professional Services role designing and configuring low-code business applications for government customers, including data models, workflow automation, integrations, and limited scripting.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Mid-level Professional Services role designing and configuring low-code business applications for government customers, including data models, workflow automation, integrations, and limited scripting.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of total work experience, including 3+ years in low-code/no-code platforms or enterprise application configuration roles.
- Understanding of data modeling.
- Experience implementing business workflow automation.
- Working knowledge of JavaScript or a similar scripting language for implementing business rules.
- Experience with integrations using REST APIs, file-based transfers, event-based workflows, or batch processes.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in GovTech or public-sector workflows.
- Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing implementation.
- Familiarity with role-based access control and data governance practices.
- Understanding of data modeling, including entity relationships, referential integrity, normalization, and denormalization.
- Experience designing and implementing business workflows and approval automation.
- Ability to translate complex business processes into structured, configurable application logic.
- Experience integrating third-party APIs and embedding their outputs into larger application workflows.
- Understanding of security standards and API documentation tools.
- Experience working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Pune, India area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
